resources.reason: Recorded by the task's own Resource Manifest table row; retained in place.
Windows junction found inside the worktree during restoration; recorded because it physically exists, not because a row names it.

notes: RESTORED, not original. The original was never committed, so there is nothing to compare against; restored_by and restoration_basis are here so nobody has to guess whether a recreated artefact is genuine.
Method follows GOV-P15-MANIFEST-1: restore only what existing records support, never invent fields.
Junctions found on disk are registered even though the task's table did not name them - physical truth outranks textual silence, per that task's review.
